title: Europe should beware of buying America’s increasingly unaccountable AI killing-machines
lede: As Washington hands its autonomous warfare roadmap to Musk and other defence-industry moguls, European leaders in Geneva must decide whether to copy a model that speeds up killing, while hollowing out accountability for civilian deaths.
